picks.showTitle: Quran in a Year+ (with Imam Saif Morad)
picks.title: Day 351- When Truth Conflicts With Desire | Tur 42-49, Najm 1-26
picks.summary: In today’s episode, we explore what happens when you know what is right, but your nafs wants something else.As Surah al-Tur closes, Allah teaches us how to remain patient when life feels unfair, falsehood seems powerful, and circumstances are beyond our control. Then Surah al-Najm turns our attention to revelation, reminding us that the Prophet ﷺ came with sound knowledge, sound judgment, and guidance from Allah.We look at the struggle between guidance and desire, why doubts and cravings can distort the way we see truth, and Ibn al-Qayyim’s powerful distinction between real hope and mere wishf
picks.reason: Deep reflection on struggle between desire and divine guidance in Quranic surahs.

picks.showTitle: Quran Garden - The Holy Quran Explained in Clear English (English Tafsir)
picks.title: Surah An-Nisaa: The Women - Verse 47 - Allah's Curse
picks.summary: In today's tafsir, we respond to critics of the Quran who claim that Muslims cannot agree on the meaning of its verses.  We examine the meanings behind the word "curse" and explore how God's blessings are often hidden behind life's difficulties.
picks.reason: A thoughtful tafsir on divine curse and blessings behind hardship in Quranic verses.

picks.showTitle: Quran Garden - The Holy Quran Explained in Clear English (English Tafsir)
picks.title: Surah An-Nisaa: The Women - Verse 49 - I AM the BEST Muslim
picks.summary: What if I told you that one of the biggest spiritual dangers isn't sin, but thinking you're already good enough?  The Quran exposes a trap that has fooled religious people for centuries: convincing themselves they are pure, chosen, and guaranteed God's favor.  In today's tafseer, we'll uncover why Allah rejects self-righteousness and when it's actually okay to speak positively about yourself.
picks.reason: Explores spiritual danger of self-righteousness and humility in Quranic teaching.
